_meta.notes: Census 2022 (P0301.4, released 2023-10-10): 17,828,778 households, average size 3.5, 79% of households with internet access (35% in 2011). Previously stored values (17.3M households, size 3.0, internet 64.0%) did not match the release and were corrected. UNRESOLVED: census-no-income (30.4%) was NOT verified — Stats SA withheld/excluded the income, employment, fertility and mortality themes from Census 2022 outputs over quality concerns (see municipalities.json notes); the 30.4% figure and its 2011 comparison should be traced to a published table or the record removed. internet-access 2016 (48.0) is a Community Survey point and household 2001 (10.9) was not re-verified. Stats SA has said Census 2022 results will not be revised; no errata were found.
_meta.public_notes: Census 2022 values (Stats SA P0301.4, released 10 October 2023). The 2016 internet-access point comes from the Community Survey, not a census. The share of households with no income (30.4%) has not yet been traced to a published Census 2022 table. Census 2022 had an estimated net undercount of about 31%; Stats SA considers the data fit for use and has said it will not revise the results.

statistics.title: Households counted
statistics.description: Total private households counted in Census 2022: 17,828,778, up from 14.4 million in 2011 (+23.4%). Average household size declined from 3.6 persons in 2011 to 3.5 in 2022.

statistics.title: Households with internet access
statistics.description: Percentage of households with access to the internet (by any means, including mobile) in Census 2022, up from 35% in 2011. The rapid expansion of mobile internet is the primary driver.

statistics.title: People aged 15 and older with no income
statistics.description: Percentage of individuals 15 years and older who reported no income in Census 2022. This includes the unemployed, students, and those who are economically inactive.
